# HASTS (History, Anthropology, and Science, Technology & Society) at MIT

> > MIT's interdisciplinary doctoral program exploring the intersections of history, anthropology, science, technology, and society through research, teaching, and public scholarship.

HASTS is a unique graduate program at MIT that brings together scholars studying the social, cultural, and historical dimensions of science and technology. The program fosters interdisciplinary research and supports graduate student initiatives like ContraSTS magazine, while hosting dissertation presentations and academic events.

## Key Topics

- History, Anthropology, and STS (HASTS)
- Interdisciplinary doctoral program
- Science, technology, and society
